title: DomainTrail diagnostics (dt check --format json, dt generate ts --format json)
description: One document on stdout. 'diagnostics' and 'summary' are present once the check has run; 'error' only when the command failed for another reason than the diagnostics themselves (missing root, invalid config, no .dt file, generation refused). The exit code is the same as with --format text.

diagnostics.description: Sorted by file, line, column and code.

written.description: generate ts only: the output directories written, relative to the working directory.

hints.description: generate ts only: advice about the project, as the lines that --format text prints after 'hint: ' (e.g. no lint rule against casts to domain types; see dt guide lint).

error.description: Why the command failed, as the one line that --format text prints on stderr.

file.description: Path of the .dt file relative to the root.

code.description: Rule ID (see the Rules section of `dt guide`), or SYNTAX for lexer / parser errors.

hint.description: What to change, when the message does not say it: a fix, or `did you mean 'X'?` for an unresolved name.
